Hi,

we have a question regarding Trochomancy:

Trochomancy
Action Modifier
Requires nec or nec/aus

nec: Remove 13 cards in the target Methuselah's ash heap from the game
to get +1 bleed. Not usable if there aren't enough cards in that ash
heap. You cannot play another action modifier to increase this bleed.

nec aus: as above, but remove only 7 cards.

NEC AUS: as above, but for +2 bleed.

Do the cards need to be removed from the ashheap of the methuselah
currently being bled when playing Trochomancy or can you use it on any
methuselah's ashheap? And is it correct to assume that the cards are
removed as soon as you play Trochomancy?

Thanks,

Bernd

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Feb 3, 2:42 pm, Asnek wrote:

> > > > Card text: "target Methuselah's ash heap".
> > > So target means the target of the bleed in this instance?
> > Yeah. That's the only option for its meaning in this instance.

> Just one more to be sure:
> cards are removed at the moment of playing the card or at the moment
> of resolving the bleed? in case of some bounces for example...

Action modifiers resolve when played.
The bleed target at the moment you play the card loses the cards from
their ash heap.
